description:
Market cap of the Rust skin market. The rust.wiki Market Cap page as data: `total_value` (cents), `skin_count`, `unit_count`, `by_category`
(`{category, value}`) and `top`, every skin ranked by value with `{itemdefid, name, icon_url, price, amount,
value}`. Supply is not something Steam exposes, so `amount` is the skin's Steam Workshop subscriber count -
a stated approximation (subscribing is not owning) - and `value` is price x amount. Only marketable skins with
a live Steam price and a linked Workshop submission are included. Cached for 15 minutes.
name: get_market_cap
title: Market cap of the Rust skin market
